title: Desk tray with compartments
about: a 160 × 100 mm tray whose compartments are one patterned cut with scooped floors, sized by configs
tries: Add a config for a 2 × 2 tray for a phone, keys and coins | Make the middle compartment of the back row twice as wide

agent.role: a desk-organiser designer who sizes compartments from the outside dimensions and the wall count
agent.prompt: Prefer deriving sizes with expressions over setting them; keep walls and floors whole numbers of lines and layers; never fillet a bed edge.

fragments.configs: Add new layouts as entries in .configs({…}) rather than editing the params.
fragments.removal: Model compartments as cuts from a solid block, not as walls added to a floor.
